extensions.evidence_summary: Darker same blue family for thin frames and clear shafts; source medium-blue outlines guide this derivation.
Near-white green tint subordinate to the small source green focus; used only for the bottleneck local region.

relationships.observation: Thin medium-blue rounded outlines directly enclose pale-blue mask cells.
Two close low-saturation blue cell families occupy neighboring matrix regions without a harsh boundary.
Blue bordered cells and the green query-stream label are separated by white margin; green occupies only small text/mark areas.
Neutral gray mask cells border pale-blue available cells; pale regions retain dark readable labels.

colour_decision.rationale: Choose one primary blue family plus a restrained separated green mechanism focus from the complete Transcormer SVG. Deep blue is a shade of its actual outline colour; near-white green is a tint of its query-stream green. White stays dominant. Do not reproduce the source mask matrix layout or grey blocked-cell semantics.
colour_decision.adjacency_review: Related encoder/decoder cells use neighboring pale source blues with deep blue linework. Strongest local colour is the small green-tinted transformer mechanism at the bottom; white around it separates it from blue feature columns. Same-scale skip shafts stay deep blue; green is not scattered across unrelated readouts. White regions and black text preserve figure hierarchy.
colour_decision.whitespace_plan: Keep canvas and major frames white. Only feature cells, transformer interior and tiny readout marks receive pale colour. Leave broad clear gutters and the U interior white. Title and section headings never receive a band.

topology_review: The original AlphaGenome science requires convolutional downsampling to a 128-bp transformer and upsampling to 1 bp with same-scale encoder/decoder skips. A 128-bp transformer tap and the restored 1-bp decoder stream feed output embeddings; pair features from the transformer independently feed contacts at 2,048 bp. Two macro outputs from backbone are therefore a necessary source-supported exception, with distinct internal landings at the 1D output embedder and 2D pair representation. No gate, multiply, arbitrary add or BPE operator from HyenaDNA/DNABERT is inserted. Repeated actual network levels are summarized; 1 bp and 4 bp are selected scale examples with ellipses down to the only 128-bp bottleneck. No pooling below this bottleneck.
brief: Create an airy publication diagram using the source whole-reference language: fine uniform outlined enclosures, plain readable typographic labels, small functional pale shapes, simple continuous arrows, large white space. Use a coherent Times-like serif for body labels inspired by the inspected CosyVoice SVG; use bold serif for headings and mathematical/native symbols consistently. Avoid enormous title branding. Set a compact 1 Mb DNA input left, largest central backbone, and two unequal output frames right. Preserve all source-grounded topology. Blue source cells/shades show representations, tiny near-white green focuses the Transformer Tower; black text and unfilled titles. No gradients or shadows. Native schematic genomic marks only. Correct the earlier ambiguous 128 bp label placement: ONLY mark 128 bp in the bottleneck and output-embedding/readout labels, never halfway down the encoder. Use 4 bp for the selected middle skip scale and ellipses to summarize intermediate scale stages. Within the backbone use two smooth skip curves rather than complex orthogonal pipes. The macro grid/ports in the resulting plan are exact; all local words and marks are contained.

ideas.concept: Make the U-shaped scale transition and the two distinct output representations visible
ideas.visual_intent: Prevent an incorrect extra downsampling stage while retaining real skip and pair dependencies
ideas.construction_plan: Inside the model frame place encoder left x650–880 and decoder right x1160–1390. Top selected 1-bp features at y410, middle selected 4-bp features at y650. Encoder down arrows descend toward one Transformer Tower centered x1000 y1010 and decoder arrows ascend from it; use ellipses between 4-bp strips and bottleneck to summarize unshown levels. Mark 128 bp only within Transformer Tower. Two smooth single-curve skip arrows connect corresponding encoder/decoder feature strips; label Same-scale skips once inside their whitespace. Place Output embeddings as small right-side region x1450–1660 y400–630, receiving decoder-top 1-bp features by one straight arrow and the 128-bp tower tap by one unobstructed smooth curve in the empty right inner corridor. Output embeddings connects directly to the upper-right genomic frame at y500. Pair embeddings as a compact blue matrix at x1450–1660 y1080–1240 receives its own simple curve from transformer and connects directly to lower-right contacts at y1150. Keep the pair path below the decoder. No overlapping pipes, no shared arrowhead, no staircase.

ideas.concept: Group all assay types by resolution and keep contacts separate
ideas.visual_intent: Explain the biological readout families without presenting invented measurements
ideas.construction_plan: In the tall upper-right region, align 1-bp headings, three short grouped modality lines and small schematic profiles; donor–acceptor arcs distinguish splicing. A simple divider separates 128-bp histone/TF readouts. Lower contact region contains a symmetric schematic diagonal matrix and 2,048-bp label. Curves and grids are symbolic without numerical axes or empirical scores. Schematic readouts appears once in ordinary dark italic text inside the lower contact frame.
